nom: Personal Day Everybody Stay Calm Recovery Mask

avis.texte: This unfortunately made my face feel warm upon first use which is never a good sign. My jaw was slightly itchy after so something in this product im sensitive too. Im assuming its one of the acids :( I had to return. If u want a calming mask check out Lush " catastrophe cosmetic", its my holy grail
Feels amazing and love using it after and good everything shower!
Loving this after I use my topical retinoid or the resurfacing peel to treat and prevent acne. Hydrates super well where my skin used to get flaky and dry. Will buy this again for sure!
I'm in LOVE with this. It has been the best especially after my facials.
My skin is very sensitive and reactive. This really helps calm any redness or inflammation in my skin.
I have dry skin and blackheads, so this is a mask for after I do an exfoliation treatment. It soothes how sensitive my skin feels after the resurfacing peel.

avis.titre: Nice mask, not sure it's doing much
avis.texte: This is a nice mask but I'm not sure how much it is doing for my skin- not super clarifying and not super hydrating either. Wouldn't repurchase but overall I love Personal Day products- they're my go to!
I fell in love with the new packaging, super easy to use and apply! Plus more product
I am new to the brand and I've been so pleased with everything I've purchased. This product has been a great addition to my routine and seems to be helping immensely with redness!
I tend to have drier skin and this mask brings my skin back to life every time I use it. Smells nice too!

avis.titre: Great for self care and reset
avis.texte: I love this because I can use it while on accutane and it doesn't irritate my skin
Use it after the peel and really makes my skin feel smooth and moisturized!
I have been using this twice a week and have definitely noticed a major improvement in redness and texture. Will definitely purchase this one again!

Such a soothing and gentle recovery mask. My Skin had been doing well for a while and then I used the wrong Makeup and had a full-blown face reaction and bought this almost immediately and it helped cure and calm that down, so thank you.
I switch between this and the other mask - if my skin feels prorated this really calms it down.

I work long hours tucked away in a hospital lab that always leaves my skin feeling so dry! This mask helps revive my skin after I've worked a stretch. I also have the resurfacing peel mask they have and I like to use it after that one to help the recovery process along.

I am an avid mask trier - I have acne prone, sensitive, clog prone skin. This mask has great ingredients, but for the price I will not be buying it again. I barely got 3 uses out of this mask. It makes my skin feel nice, but doesnt help enough to make it worth the price.
I love pairing this with the even keel resurfacing peel. Doing the recovery mask after the peel leaves my skin feeling so refreshed and pampered. Game-changing!
I use this after the even keel resurfacing mask and it makes my skin feel so soft and moisturized. And as a bonus it smells amazing!

avis.titre: The only mask that I've used that reduces redness immediatel
avis.texte: I love this mask and keep coming back to it. It's the only face mask I've found that significantly reduces my acne and redness. My holy grail product!
I use this two times a week and totally notice a difference if I miss a week. Makes my skin feels so good and my texture goes away.

I am not going through any skin concers at the moment (barrier is fine) but this products burned for a moment upon application. It also left my skin drier despite not having any majot actives and exfoliants. It did not fee like it left my skin soothed.

I absolutely love this mask! I feel like it's the reset for my skin when it starts getting out of control with breakouts or dryness. 10/10 product that leaves my skin feeling so incredibly soft and refreshed! I just wish it was carried in stores, or at least not out of stock all the time online.

I do really enjoy this product - I see a slight improvement in skin hydration overall - and it does not break me out which is so nice. I look forward to using this after a stressful day, and waking up the next day to plump skin. But the box seems large - but the container for the mask is half the size of the box. And the mask container itself isn't filled to the brim - which is overall disappointing. I can admit it says the fluid ounces on the outside, so it is my bad! But for this price .. there just isn't enough product to justify it. I'll only get this again if it's on sale, or I have a coupon, and will actively search for alternatives. Sorry!

I've been using a majority of PD products in my skincare routine lately and I see a significant difference!! I have oily skin and I don't generally have redness, but I do get breakouts and pimples along my chin and cheeks. My skin has been clearing up more recently and this particular product just makes my skin feel SO SOFT when I wake up in the morning. It doesn't feel tight or oily at all. I will say, this product makes my lips tingle a lil but it isn't bad.

Ive never left a review but this mask was so amazing I had to. Used it after a resurfacing mask, rinsed off and used the personal day moisturizer then went to bed. When I woke up my skin was so smooth and glowing! All the texure I had was gone and my skin felt so moisturized and nourished. Will be stocking up on this stuff!
I feel like it's given me the glass skin that I've always wanted and it also feels so good on my skin.
It works but it did make my skin a little tingly, which always worries me. I do think with consistent use I've seen improvement in texture.

I love this mask. I have very oily skin and am acne-prone. So a fair amount of BHAs and Benzoyl Peroxide are a part of my routine. This has been the perfect add to help re-balance and quench my skin while still letting the harsher actives do their thing. Often, masks like these leave me too shiny. This one is perfect.
I usually use this mask following the 'Even Keel Resurfacing Peel.' It works great and calms any redness from the peel. I love it!

avis.titre: Calms my skin - most effective face mask I've ever tried
avis.texte: This face mask is so incredible! When I do the face mask for 15mins before bed, I actually notice such a difference the next morning my skin is less red, more clear of acne & more soft. I highly recommend this product. I've never noticed such a difference using a face mask before.
I'm loving this mask to soothe my sensitive skin! Excited to make this part of my routine.
Purchased from Revolve on a whim. So glad I did. Love that this supports acne prevention AND recovery. Great for sensitive skin, too!
This mask is the go to that keeps my skin in check, it's absolutely perfect. Calming and lovely :)

I've been suffering with acne since I was 16 years old, and I'm 26 now and man I love this mask. It soothes active pimples, makes my skin feel super hydrated, and ultimately makes me feel confident in this product. I definitely will be purchasing frequently.

I used this mask on my face when I had an eczema flare up and it mildly helped - the flaky skin stayed flaky, but the pain and itchiness were gone. I'm quite surprised! I followed up the mask with the Personal Day routine - it's not very irritating to my eczema, but it doesn't really help either, so the fact that nothing hurt after the mask is even more surprising. My usual skincare routine does not provide this kind of effect.
The mask is a perfect recovery product from any exfoliator or drying product you may use. Will definitely keep using.

This mask is great! I don't usually have acne prone skin but it is pretty sensitive. After I use this my skin feels super soft and rejuvenated! I would definitely recommend this product - the price is also amazing.
Whenever my skin gets irritated or inflamed (and red) this mask helps calm it down to a manageable level.
The "tingle" of the cooling kinda threw me off, and I was worried I'd have a bad reaction, but my skin is soft and bright! I love using it after the peel.
I Loveeeee this mask. I have the most sensitive, reactive skin and this mask has a way of calming and soothing it, making it feel so soft and hydrated.

I have about 50 different wash-off masks, but I reach for this one the most often now. It's soothing and helps with any redness and any irritation from a breakout that I have. I have dry skin and this mask is hydrating enough that I can use it a few days a week.

I use this mask every 2-3 days as recommended right after using the peel. My skin instantly feels nourished. I wake up with glowing skin. Don't be too discouraged if you notice more breakouts the next day, it's the mask bringing the gunk to the surface so it can leave your skin. I've been using the mask for almost 2 months and my blemishes overall are smaller than they used to be before using Personal Day products. I use the cleanser, acne treatment, moisturizer, peel, and mask in conjunction.

I have been using the peel mask a lot (it's my favorite personal day product) and so when I saw that they launched the moisturizing/calming mask I immediately bought it! I really like this mask, my skin feels extremely hydrated afterwards!

I have tried every product under the sun from prescription to high end skincare products and this mask exceeded my expectations! I have severe eczema, redness and irritation from breakouts and this literally calmed my entire face overnight. I will forever keep this mask as part of my skincare routine.
Starting a new skincare routine? Is your period about to start? Weather changing? All the things that stress my skin out this mask solves. Hydrating even the next day.
I love how soft this mask makes my skin feel and the extra hydration I get :)
Soothing and calmed my red skin! Adore this and would love to try the other version!!!!!

I am a wash off mask junkie, have used/tried 300+ masks over the years and use one most mornings. This mask is so calming and soothing when I need that for my skin. Very gentle and my skin is hydrated and calm when I rinse it off. Not just great for acne irritation, but any skin irritation including environmental which is a big skin stressor for me. My only wish is that it could be sold in a bigger size as well as the current size for those of us that use it a lot.
I love this mask so much that I bought one to give to my sister who has problem skin! It is so soothing without breaking you out. Highly recommend
Love to use this mask once or twice a week to keep redness and irritation at bay! Even used it the night before my wedding to make sure my skin was as calm and clear as possible the next morning

I like to apply it right after I get out of the shower and it makes my skin so calm and smooth. I have combination acne prone skin and this has helped combat the redness and dryness that comes with the change in seasons.
This product is very helpful in providing hydration and making my skin feel refreshed and smooth.

avis.titre: Truly the epitome of a recovery mask! Helps the skin feel so
avis.texte: This mask is amazing. It feels so lightweight on your skin and when you wash it off your skin truly feels refreshed and cleaner. Non irritating and non drying. I only use it once a week and feel like I see a difference in brightness every time.
Amazing and refreshing !! Really helps control the oilyness !!
Perfect for using after doing the peel. Very hydrating and soothing to the skin. I do it 1-2 nights a week and always wake up with the most plump and smooth skin in the morning!
So calming and cooling when used after the peel. My go to for a little added moisture l
Using this 1-2 times a week and love how nice it feels. Slight tingle and is so refreshing. Also doesn't make me break out and everything does.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling plump and hydrated.
avis.texte: I genuinely love this mask. I use it once a week and each time my skin comes out looking glowy and plump after. It also leaves my skin feeling super soft to the touch. Price point is a little high for me, but a little goes a long way so it'll last you.
So impressed by this mask. It left my skin feeling so smooth!

This mask instantly soothes and calms any redness or irritation, leaving my face feeling soft and refreshed. The formula is super gentle but works so well to hydrate and restore my skin's balance. It's perfect after a long day or whenever my skin needs a little extra TLC. I love how it leaves my skin feeling relaxed and healthy—this mask is a must-have!
This mask leaves your skin feeling refreshed and calm. It does not irritate and it MOISTURIZES!

avis.titre: Where has this been all my life!?
avis.texte: I'm obsessed with this! It's so soothing. When I have a spot pop up that's itchy or red, I use the mask as a spot treatment and rub it in like moisturizer. Normally with acne like that it'll be itchy and red on and off all day, but the recovery mask truly stops both within 15min and I don't have anymore redness or itching after that. This is for sure remaining in my rotation!
I love this product, it's so effective and it feels great. I use it weekly and love the results. My skin feels so much softer and hydrated afterwards.

Literally the best feeling of all time is coming home from a long day at work and using this mask on my face. It feels so nice on my skin and I can see so much of a difference after using it! It really does feel so calming and like I can finally take a deep breath when I have it on. I absolutely love it!!

This mask is a great pair with the peel. After treating the acne with a stronger product (like the peel) my skin needs a little rest and vitamins. That's what this feels like. A good rejuvenating mask to finish everything off with a cherry on top.
